findings.title: Reflection response key is `question`, design specifies `question_id`
findings.where: app/stress-lab/results/[simulationId].tsx (submitReflection / reflectionAnswers) vs design.md stress_reflections ([{ question_id, answer }])
findings.problem: The route writes reflection responses as [{ question, answer }] and reads them back with the same `question` key. The design and the table comment describe the shape as [{ question_id, answer }]. save_reflection only clamps the `answer` field and does not enforce the key name, so the client is internally consistent (write key == read key) and there is no functional bug, but the persisted shape deviates from the documented contract.
findings.fix: Rename the response key to `question_id` in both the write (submitReflection) and read (reflectionAnswers) paths to match design.md and the table comment, or update the design/table comment to `question`. Cosmetic/contract-consistency only; not blocking.
